title: J.P. Morgan Announces New Private Equity Team Focused on Sustainable Growth, First Strategy to Target Investments in High Growth Private Climate Companies
主要内容: J.P. Morgan has launched a new private equity team focused on sustainable growth, targeting high-growth private companies in scalable climate technologies. The team's first strategy involves an investment of up to $150 million, one of its largest capital commitments into an alternative investment strategy. The initiative reflects the firm's commitment to integrating sustainability into its investment strategies, leveraging big data capabilities and extensive networks with growth-stage companies. Tanya Barnes, previously at Blackstone Group and Goldman Sachs, will lead the initiative, while Dr. Sarah Kapnick, J.P. Morgan's Senior Climate Scientist and Sustainability Strategist, will serve on the investment committee. Brian Carlin, CEO of J.P. Morgan Private Capital, emphasized the team's role in addressing the sustainability transition and meeting investor demand beyond public markets.
